lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10-11 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines are visible traversing the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, narrowing slightly as they approach the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several vertical lines on the anterior torso and the line immediately preceding the hindquarters terminate abruptly mid-flank, not reaching the ventral or dorsal boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of 4-5 distinct white spots is visible on the lower haunch, positioned above the stifle joint on the lateral plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a spiral, lyrate trajectory, emerging from the skull at an approximately 60-degree vertical angle before curving inward toward the midline.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 15-20% of the total visible vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white chevron is visible across the nasal bridge between the eyes, and distinct white transverse bands are present on the lower limbs above the hooves.
